supports.note: Reported collision counts are extensive. Every published 2021 LSOA in this source has one verified May 2023 local-authority parent, so values are regrouped exactly; no area weighting is used.

Census 2021 usual-resident counts are extensive. Every 2021 LSOA in England and Wales has one verified May 2023 local-authority parent in the official ONS lookup, so counts are regrouped exactly, including into the four authorities created in April 2023; no area or population weighting is used.
